'''Prax Inc''' was a [[Xiytiar-class heavy transport|''Xiytiar''-class heavy transport]] that was present at [[Calast]], a [[Golan Space Colony 2]] space station during the [[Rescue at Bundil II]]. The ship contained [[Holodrama/Legends|Holodramas]].
